# Claude Code 2.1.241 identity

Frozen against npm `@anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.241`. Host `claude` was
not installed. Missing install is not a gap. The host was not replaced.

Official linux-x64 `claude --help` is byte-identical to `2.1.238`.
`identity.json` and `protocol.json` record the headless axis.
`response-only.json` records the separate response-only axis. Neither
replaces the `claude-code-2.1.220` headless decoder specimen, the
`2.1.227`/`2.1.228` response-only specimens, the frozen `2.1.234`/
`2.1.235`/`2.1.238` identity corpora, nor the `2.1.238` structured-output
evidence stop. `headless-ultracode.json` records the g04.065 Ultracode evidence
stop at the qualified ceiling. `headless-maximum-turns.json` records the
g04.079 `--max-turns` evidence across every published version in
`2.1.220..=2.1.241`, probed on darwin-arm64 native executables. No provider
prompt was sent.
